author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally had its first big gameplay reveal, giving us our first real look at Rockstar's massive open-world and the amount of detail it holds. It's one that might be the most visually-impressive game we've ever seen, according to the experts at Digital Foundry.

Digital Foundry's Oliver Mackenzie and Richard Leadbetter have praised GTA 6's visual presentation, with Mackenzie specifically going as far to call it the "most impressive example of real-time game rendering" he's ever seen. The pair praised a slew of details showcased in the gameplay, including standout character rendering, especially the hair physics and skin details across not just the game's protagonist, but many
title: Tech Experts Call Grand Theft Auto 6 The Most Visually Advanced Game To Date, Which Explains Why It’s Stuck At 30FPS

author: Richard Li
description: My actual experience of Fable's combat is far different from the disappointing footage released earlier this week.
title: Fable Hands-On Impressions

author: Blair Marnell
description:
The annual Gamescom event is meant to showcase some of the best upcoming video games, but at least two apparent thefts have thrown a damper on this year's festivities. Indie developer Ryan Laley reported that his equipment was stolen from his Gamescom booth, which he said was "a huge blow financially and mentally." Fortunately, Laley has received an outpouring of support from the industry, including The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 developer CD Projekt Red.

On X, CD Projekt Red responded to Laley's initial me
title: CD Projekt Red Offers To Help Gamescom Theft Victim As Industry Shows Its Support

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Nvidia hasn't yet announced a release date for DLSS 5, which it revealed to widespread backlash earlier this year. But a recent leak has provided PC modders the ability to inject the neural rendering in almost any game, which is being used to showcase just how awful its AI-powered face filters can get.

Accidentally included in a build of NBA 2K27 (via VideoCardz), an early version of DLSS 5 was accessed and made useable by the RenoDX modding community, who quickly developed a crude toolset allowing anyone to use the suite across a variety of games. These ranged from extensive tests on Control,
title: Leaked DLSS 5 Mod Shows Just How Much Nvidia’s AI Filter Can Mess With Your Games

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Despite mixed messages when it comes to when we can expect the next PlayStation and Xbox, one aspect about the next generation seems to be clearer than ever: Discs are going away. Earlier this year, Sony announced that it would be ending physical disc production for all PlayStation games launching after January 2028, confirming that the company's next console will almost certainly be digital-only. Microsoft hasn't made as strong a statement yet, instead opting to introduce a program allowing Xbox owners to convert some of their physical games into perpetual digital licenses. But it's a program that would not need to exist if the next Xbox was being designed with a disc drive in mind.

Despite some confusion around the initial reveal,
title: Xbox’s Disc-To-Digital Program Means Microsoft Is Probably Done With Discs Too

author: Jordan Ramée
description:
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy faces a difficult balancing act. Can it move away from its predecessors' terrifying waves of rats and still deliver a supernatural terror that ties into rewarding environmental puzzles? Can it ditch the series' sibling protagonists and still tell a moving story focused on two people learning to lean on one another? And can it add fierce, frenetic combat to the franchise's formula as a new gameplay pillar without abandoning its core identity as a puzzle game? At times, Resonance succeeds--especially during its stronger first half--but it too often loses its footing. And as the game increasingly misses the mark, it further distances itself from what worked so well in the first two A Plague Tale games without adding anything to make up for the loss.

Set in 1334, about 15 years prior to the first two A Plague Tale g
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy Is Good If You Do The Necessary Homework Beforehand

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft's new Fable game was supposed to launch this year, but it was delayed to February 2027. The game's director, Ralph Fulton, said in an interview that he feels "great" about the launch timing for Fable, adding that shifting to 2027 helps the game avoid the "chaotic window" of its original timeframe of late 2026.

Speaking to IGN, Fulton said the reason for the delay "is pretty apparent to everybody." He said he was "really looking forward to" launching Fable in 2026, saying he wasn't happy about having another all-hands meeting with
title: Fable Dev Happy About Delay To 2027 To Avoid “Chaotic Window,” And We All Know That Means GTA 6

author: Phil Owen
description:
Disney and Epic Games caused a bit of a stir recently when they unveiled their latest collaboration: a Fortnite skin that you can only get by riding the Millennium Falcon: Smuggler's Run ride at Disneyland in California or Disney World in Florida. There's been a lot of spirited discussion about this skin since then, as most of the folks who had something to say about the situation seemed pretty annoyed about it. 

Honestly, even though I just made my once-per-decade visit to Disneyland back in June, I think it's a pretty cool idea, because the skin they're offering is something almost nobody would have cared about were it released the way Fortnite skins usually are.

The skin in question is Forsworn Trooper, a generic criminal sport
title: It’s Totally Fine For Epic To Lock A Fortnite Skin Behind A Trip To Disneyland

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
GTA 6 takes place in Vice City, which is a stand-in for Miami, and it appears the game will feature a Miami apartment building from a popular TV show.

Eagle-eyed fans noticed that Dexter Morgan's apartment in Miami from the TV show Dexter appears to be in GTA 6. The TV show is set in Miami and the exterior shots were filmed at the Bay Harbor Club condos in Miami. You can see comparison images below.
title: GTA 6 Looks Like It Features This Popular TV Show Apartment

author: Steve Watts
description:
Star Wars Zero Company is a great take on the XCOM-like turn-based tactics game, and as I said in my review, it actually pushes the genre forward with a blend of new ideas and excellent execution. But as laudable as that is, Zero Company actually managed to accomplish something much more daunting: it made me care about the Clone Wars era of Star Wars.

I am an old-timer of a Star Wars fan, raised on the original trilogy, and I have distinct memories of watching the prequel films. I enjoyed them, I convinced myself I loved them, but over time the shine of "new Star Wars" faded and I was left with movies that were largely mediocre. I've since settled into a position taken by lots of Star Wars fans, and especially those my age: I give George Lucas credit for having some interesting ideas and a distinct authorial vision for his universe--
title: Star Wars Zero Company Actually Made Me Care About The Clone Wars Era

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Alien Isolation 2 stars a new protagonist named Blake. Creative Assembly has been clear about this all summer, but it's only now that I'm letting it sink in. Since I first played a demo of the survival-horror game at Summer Game Fest's Play Days this past June, I've been holding onto a theory that Blake's role in the story is a bait-and-switch--that in short order Blake would be impaled by the Xenomorph and Amanda Ripley, star of the first game, would show up as the real playable character. 

But it's time I let go of that pet theory of mine.

Every time Creative Assembly talks about this game, the team highlights Blake's story. There's too much investment on the team's end for me to keep believing they have a trick up their sleeve. 

"Wh
title: It’s Time I Let Go Of My Favorite Alien Isolation 2 Theory

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
The XCOM series has been effectively on hiatus for many years now, and AAA turn-based-tactics games have been pretty hard to come by recently. That's changing, however, starting with this week's launch of Star Wars Zero Company. It's effectively a marriage of classic XCOM gameplay and Clone Wars-era Star Wars storytelling, and within a few minutes of starting it, I got that same rush of excitement I got the first time I played an XCOM game. 

Typically, I try to savor turn-based tactical experiences like this as much as possible, because I know it's going to be at least a few years before something like it comes along again. The last XCOM-esque turn-based-tactics game I can even recall playing was
title: Turn-Based-Tactics Fans Are Suddenly Eating Very Well

author: Evan Campbell
description:
You might expect people to talk about the visuals, lighting, action sequences, or gunplay after Grand Theft Auto VI's brand-new extended-look trailer showed off over 25 minutes of new footage. But the top comments on Rockstar's YouTube upload of the video deal more with the human condition than expected. In fact, there's quite a bit of talk about death and remembrance.

The top comment (at the time of publication) states: "a moment of silence for people that didn't make it here." Meanwhile, another person writes: "Objective: Stay alive till release day." It's been a long wait for GTA 6, especially since GTA 5 originally launched almost 13 years ago.
title: GTA 6’s Long Wait Has People Realizing Their Own Mortality

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
A very important piece of news has come to light about GTA 6: You can pick up dog poop and throw it at people in the upcoming open-world crime game.

YouTuber TGG visited Rockstar North's offices and spoke with the team, and one of the things he learned was how dog poop can be a weapon.

"If someone is out on the street and they're walking their dog, and the dog takes a dump, you can wait for the person to pick up the dog sh** with a doggie bag, and then you can hit that person, making them drop that doggie bag full of dog crap, and then you can actually pick th
title: GTA 6 Lets You Throw Dog Poop At People

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar finally lifted the veil on GTA 6 during a high-profile Netflix event on August 27. The nearly 30-minute video revealed a lot. We saw main characters Jason and Lucia in action in snippets of multiple different missions, while there were cutscenes and character interactions on display as well.

The broadcast also featured a new look at some of the updated gameplay systems, like how NPCs will
title: GTA 6: All The Biggest Takeaways From The Big New Trailer That You Need To Know

author: Steve Watts
description:
At the heart of many great action-RPGs is a satisfying grind for better loot. Whether it's random chests or quest rewards, it's important to feel like you're getting appropriate payoffs for overcoming challenges. Playground Games, the studio behind the upcoming Fable reboot, told GameSpot it's aiming to make sure that its loot and equipment feels meaningful, with big swings in power level.

Creative directors Will Kennedy and Craig Littler told us in an interview at Gamescom that there's lots of variety in the kinds of loot you'll find, and the particularly impactful ones will be new gear.

"We want our upgrades to be what we call meaningfully meaningful," Kennedy said. "So you don't get things like, 'Oh, 1% damage,' and things like that. What you get is
title: Fable’s Loot Is Meant To Be Meaningful, So Don’t Expect A Bunch Of Minor Upgrades

author: Erick Tay
description: We finally got hands on time with State of Decay 3 at gamescom 2026 to try out the combat, what team work looks like, exploration and more. We played the Alpha version of the game, so gameplay is subject to change.
title: State of Decay 3’s Gameplay Shows Off Combat, Team Work and More

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Alien Deathstorm is a brand-new action-horror-shooter game from Rebellion. Following the gameplay trailer's reveal at Gamescom, GameSpot was able to go hands-on, and it definitely has a retro feel with interesting-looking mechanics tied to the titular deathstorm that I wish we saw more of in the demo.

Alien Deathstorm puts players in the boots of a combat engineer, who becomes stranded on an devastated off-world colony. The planet is being ravaged by a cataclysmic "deathstorm," and it's also overrun by very aggressive aliens. In my interview with producer Martin Bellingham, the developer said it was keeping the location of the colony's planet a secret for now, but I at least recognized the area I explored to be a dilapidated nuclear reactor site. 

This specific mission required me to survive the stormy conditions and relentless waves of aliens as I fought my way inside the loca
title: Alien Deathstorm Is A Fun Shooter That (So Far) Needs More Deathstorm

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028 and the trend of consoles getting increasingly expensive. Tim Willits, the chief creative officer at Saber Interactive, caught up with GameSpot at Gamescom this week to discuss these topics and offer up a bizarre-sounding possibility for an "AI box" for games.

He said he was "surprised how upset people were" about Sony ending support for physical game discs. Willits said he hasn't bought a physical game "in a long time" because he enjoys the convenience of digital games. Willits is not alone, as the share of digita
title: Saber Boss Reacts To The Death Of Physical Games And Rising Console Prices

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
During Gamescom week, the Playground Games team working on Fable released a video showing off the game's combat. That video received a fair amount of backlash online, due to a boss appearing not to react to incoming attacks at all. Having played Fable myself now, and taking part in plenty of fights against both normal mob enemies and a boss, I think it's safe to say that the published video doesn't reflect my experience of Fable's combat.

During my time with Fable at Gamescom, I played with two different builds crafted by the development team. In both, my primary weapon was a hammer, but I had access to a normal bow with the first build and a repeater crossbow with the second. Alongside these different weapons, I had entirely different spells available.
title: No, That Video Is Not An Accurate Representation Of Fable’s Combat

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game, and for Gears of War: E-Day, developers at The Coalition are looking to give fans plenty of options for online fun. While the game's new take on Horde mode is shaping up to be the ultimate battlefield for players to enter, fans of traditional deathmatches aren't being left out in the cold either. At Gamescom, The Coalition spoke to GameSpot about E-Day's new Crucible mode and how it uses some battle royale inspiration to create a fast-paced round of 4v4 action.

The PvP mode blends your typical Gears of War spatial control with battle royale mech
title: Gears Of War: E-Day Has A Battle Royale-Inspired PvP Mode Where You Can Strip The Flesh Off Enemies

author: Erick Tay
description: Total War: Warhammer 40k is launching the franchise to new heights, uprooting its grounded tactics and sending into space and science fiction. If the full game is as good as this preview, it may be a big moment for the franchise.
title: Total War: Warhammer 40k Could Be A Big Moment For The Series

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative AI. It's a hot-button issue, and few companies have faced the level of criticism about it as Saber has. The developer recently found itself in hot water after CEO Matthew Karch lashed out at Rideshare Stimulator's former writer who said they were laid off and replaced by ChatGPT.

Now, Saber's chief creative officer, Tim Willits, has addressed the situation as well, promising that, "We will never fire someone and replace them with AI."

For anyone just catching up, Rideshare Stimulator is an upcoming Saber g
title: Saber Responds To AI Criticisms In Rideshare Game And Promises, “We Will Never Fire Someone And Replace Them With AI”

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrifying--and horny--dive into the nightmarish fiction of author Clive Barker. So far, the game is looking like the kind of Hellraiser experience that defined the franchise throughout the '80s and early '90s, and at Gamescom, Saber Interactive sat down with GameSpot to talk about the game, how far they're willing to go to nail the vibe of Hellraiser, and more.

Hellraiser: Revival launches for PC,
title: Hellraiser: Revival Is More Than Just Cenobites and Gore – 10 Things We Learned From Saber Interactive

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
When Gears of War first debuted in the Xbox 360 generation, it introduced the world to the majesty of the Lancer weapon. A gun with a brutally effective chainsaw mounted to it, the Lancer has become the defining symbol of the franchise, and in Gears of War: E-Day, players will get to see just how that weapon came to be.

In the established Gears of War lore, the weapon was created a year after the events of Emergence Day. That created something of a dilemma for the developer, The Coalition, as they had to give players something that reminded them of the classic weapon while telling a story that takes place during Emergence Day. The Solution? A Lancer prototype that's introduced in the game, and has roots in Gears of War literary stories.

"Wherever possible, we've just done every
title: Gears Of War: E-Day Had To Solve One Big Lore Problem –  How Do You Get A Lancer Into The Game?

author: Jake Dekker
description: We watched the reveal for Grand Theft Auto VI multiple times to extract the biggest takeaways. Here are 29 different things we noticed in Rockstar's next open world game.
title: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA6) – 29 Biggest Takeaways From The Reveal
